title: Annotate protein sequences with domains used for TF classification — annotate_domains
text: Protein sequences scanned HMMER domains used classification schemes choice (see list_schemes()). domain annotation set profile HMMs filtering criteria: PlantTFDB: PFAM self-built profile HMMs, domain-specific score cutoffs defined PlantTFDB (E-value threshold, domains without cutoffs). TAPscan: TAPscan v4 profile HMMs, gathering (GA) thresholds, original TAPscan implementation. CISBP: Pfam profile HMMs DNA-binding domains used CIS-BP, thresholds used CIS-BP (per-sequence E-value < 0.01 per-domain conditional E-value < 0.01). CIS-BP, overlapping hits different domains resolved keeping significant hit (lowest independent E-value). TFClass: evidence used choose among multiple TFClass families TFs CIS-BP families correspond one TFClass family (e.g., CIS-BP's Homeodomain). TFs CIS-BP family C2H2 ZF compared human mouse C2H2 ZF TFs known TFClass families based shared amino acid 5-mers, TFs scanned profile HMMs DNA-binding domains TFClass family (built human mouse TFs). See classify_tfs() details.
